What We Do

The work sheet.

Seven jobs we run start to finish — one crew, on site, from the first measure-up to the final fix-off.

JOB N°01

Custom Carpentry

Built-ins and finish joinery cut and fitted on site to suit the room.

JOB N°02

Bathroom Renovations

JOB N°06

Cladding

External cladding installed plumb and weathertight, board through to fibre cement.

JOB N°07

Granny Flats & New Builds

Standalone builds from slab to lock-up, managed on site from start to handover.

About

Sharpe Building & Constructions is a Newcastle carpentry and construction outfit — one crew, on site, from the first measure-up to the final fix-off.

Work covers renovations and new builds alike: reframing a bathroom, cladding an extension, or taking a granny flat from slab to lock-up. Every job is scoped properly before it's priced, and finished the way it was drawn.
